fact: The Ministry's Caderno de Orientações Gerais for the 2023/2024 school year, dated July 2023, states that under the Ministry's new organic law SIGE passes to the jurisdiction of the Direção Nacional da Educação, with the Direção Geral da Comunicação, Tecnologia e Multimédia responsible for its development, modernisation and technical maintenance, and that the Ministry's municipal delegates supervise it; it requires teachers to record the lesson summary and absences daily in the Livro de Ponto Digital during the lesson and to enter each assessment within 15 days, and orders all public, private and cooperative schools to join SIGE during 2023/2024.
title: Caderno de Orientações Gerais do Ano Letivo 2023/2024
